findings.claim: Meta creation should enter provider-neutral intent/blueprint/lote/validacao/recibo path, not legacy campaigns.
findings.consequence: Using legacy campaign creation paths will bypass the required human approval, idempotency, and atomic receipt mechanisms, risking unauthorized spend and duplicate campaigns.
findings.recommendation: Strictly route all Meta CREATE_PAUSED operations through the v10 intent/blueprint/lote/validacao/recibo pipeline.

findings.claim: Settings page can call updateCampaignStatus active/paused and labels Google Ads.
findings.consequence: Legacy UI might inadvertently expose Meta campaign mutation (like ENABLE) without the required v10 approval and read-back contracts.
findings.recommendation: Isolate Meta mutations from legacy settings UI. Ensure META_ENABLE requires explicit, separate authorization from META_CREATE_PAUSED.

findings.claim: Meta daily insights need parallel normalized table or provider-keyed fact model; do not overload legacy daily_campaign_metrics silently.
findings.consequence: Overloading legacy Google Ads daily metrics with Meta data will corrupt canonical facts and violate the freshness/null rules (absence is NULL, never zero).
findings.recommendation: Implement a provider-keyed fact model specifically for Meta daily insights that strictly adheres to the freshness and null rules.

findings.claim: Existing Meta code is CAPI/site event integration, not Marketing API.
findings.consequence: Confusing CAPI credentials with Marketing API credentials could lead to token leakage or incorrect permission scopes being requested.
findings.recommendation: Maintain strict separation between Meta CAPI (server event sending) and Meta Ads (media buying) credentials and data planes.

mvp_gaps: Server-side resolution of System User tokens via 1Password references is not yet implemented (currently AUSENTE).
Provider-keyed fact model for Meta daily insights is missing, risking overload of legacy Google Ads tables.
Frontend multichannel fixtures need to be replaced with actual server read models for Meta states.
Implementation of the atomic receipt (trafego_recibo) specifically for Meta's CREATE_PAUSED idempotency keys.
schema_risks: Overloading legacy 'daily_campaign_metrics' instead of creating a dedicated or provider-neutral fact model for Meta insights.
Failing to distinguish between NULL (absent/failed sync) and zero in freshness tracking, leading to false zero-spend reports.
Not utilizing 'trafego_recibo' for atomic creation, which could result in race conditions and duplicate Meta campaigns.
security_risks: Exposing raw Meta tokens in the browser or logs instead of resolving them strictly server-side via 1Password references.
Assuming the META_CREATE_PAUSED capability implicitly grants META_ENABLE capability, leading to unauthorized live spend.
Allowing external mutation (e.g., via legacy settings UI) that bypasses the v10 intent/blueprint human approval workflow.
smallest_paused_campaign_mvp: 1. READ/SYNC: Authenticate via server-side System User token to GET Business, Ad Account, Page, and Pixel references, storing them in trafego_inventario.

2. INTENT/BLUEPRINT: Operator creates a v10 intent/blueprint for a single Campaign (objective: Traffic), single AdSet (Traffic LPV, explicit advantage_audience if HEC-F, no IG Explore), and single AdCreative (Link/Image, no polls).
3. LOCAL VALIDATION: Backend validates the blueprint against v26 breaking rules (HEC-F, placements, creative types) without calling Meta.

4. EXECUTION (PAUSED): Backend executes POST /campaigns (status=PAUSED) -> POST /adsets (status=PAUSED) -> POST /adcreatives -> POST /ads (status=PAUSED), using trafego_recibo and blueprint hashes for idempotency.
5. READ-BACK: Backend performs mandatory GET on the created entities to verify status=PAUSED and stores the external IDs in trafego_linhagem.
v26_rule_risks: V26_ADVANTAGE_AUDIENCE_HECF: Failing to explicitly set targeting_automation.advantage_audience to 1/0 for Housing, Employment, and Financial categories will cause stable error META_V26_ADVANTAGE_AUDIENCE_REQUIRED.
V26_INSTAGRAM_EXPLORE_REMOVED: Sending instagram_positions=explore in AdSet targeting will result in API rejection.
V26_MESSENGER_STORIES_DEPRECATED: Relying on messenger_positions=story will fail as v26 silently removes it; read-back of effective placements is mandatory.
V26_POLL_CREATIVE_REJECTED: Allowing interactive_components_spec.type=poll in local validation or ZIP manifests will cause creative creation to fail.
V26_WEB_APP_WEB_ONLY_RESTRICTED: Permitting applink_treatment=web_only on creatives attached to Website+App campaigns will be rejected.
V26_DELIVERY_ESTIMATE_FIELDS_REMOVED: Building UI reach forecasts on daily_outcomes_curve, budget_guardrail, or estimate_dau will break as these fields are removed.
V26_SHOP_ADS_DEFAULTING: Failing to require explicit destination choice for shop advertisers will cause unintended inheritance of WEBSITE_AND_SHOP.
